jobs.title: Middle Project Manager (Sao Paulo)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented Middle Project Manager with 3+ years of experience in IT services or software development to lead a LatAm-based Salesforce delivery team in São Paulo. You will run Salesforce implementation, customization and integration projects end to end, from discovery to release and hypercare.

Our Salesforce Business Unit delivers implementation, customization, integration and managed services across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and the wider Salesforce ecosystem. We are growing in Latin America and want a PM who works well with distributed, multicultural teams, keeps delivery predictable, and uses AI tools in day-to-day project management.

Job Requirements

Must have:

3+ years as a Project Manager in IT services or software development
Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum and hybrid delivery; able to run fixed-price and T&M projects
Working knowledge of scope management, estimation, change requests and SOW-based delivery
Experience leading distributed, multicultural teams across time zones
Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills
Confident with delivery tools: Jira or Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project or similar, time-tracking and reporting tools
Practical use of AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini) for status reports, meeting notes, requirements drafts and risk analysis
Experience with AI features in delivery tools (Jira, Confluence, Notion, Miro) and AI meeting assistants
Upper-Intermediate or Advanced English

Nice To Have

Solid understanding of the Salesforce platform: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, declarative vs. custom development (Flows, Apex, LWC), integrations and the release/deployment lifecycle

Key Responsibilities

Project delivery

Plan, run and close Salesforce projects end to end: discovery, backlog, sprints, UAT, release and hypercare
Manage scope, timelines, budget and quality against the SOW, Addenda and change requests
Run Agile/Scrum ceremonies (planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and adapt to Kanban or hybrid models where needed
Coordinate release management across Salesforce environments (sandboxes, deployment pipelines) together with tech leads
Track delivery metrics (velocity, burn-down, budget burn, utilization) and act on deviations early

Team leadership

Lead a LatAm-based cross-functional team of Salesforce developers, admins, consultants, QA and BAs
Work effectively across time zones and cultures with teams in Europe, Latin America and other regions
Support onboarding, workload planning and resource allocation together with the Delivery Director
Give regular feedback to team members and contribute to performance reviews

Client communication

Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact for clients on assigned projects
Run status meetings, demos and steering updates; prepare clear written status reports
Manage stakeholder expectations and negotiate priorities and scope trade-offs
Prepare and support change requests, estimates and SOW/Addendum inputs for Delivery Director approval

Risk and reporting

Identify, log and mitigate project risks, issues and dependencies
Escalate account-level or cross-project issues to the Delivery Director in a timely way
Maintain accurate project documentation, time tracking and financial reporting (T&M and fixed-price)
Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery processes and templates within the Salesforce BU

PROJECT

Customer: International clients across multiple industries, served by the TechMagic Salesforce Business Unit.

Type: Salesforce implementation, customization, integration and managed services.

Product: Building and evolving Salesforce solutions that help clients run sales, customer service and partner/customer portals on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud. Projects range from new implementations to integrations with third-party systems and long-term managed services.

Stage: A dedicated, growing Salesforce Business Unit that is expanding its LatAm delivery team.

Project team: LatAm-based cross-functional team of Salesforce developers, admins, consultants, QA and BAs, working with distributed colleagues in Europe and other regions.

Technical stack: Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Flows, Apex, LWC), Jira / Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project or similar, AI assistants and AI features in delivery tools.

Work schedule: Full-time, São Paulo, Brazil, remote

Interview Stages

Call with recruiter
Test task
Call with Delivery Manager

Our Benefits

Opportunity to work with international clients and teams;
Work fully remotely;
English Lessons & Speaking Club;
Strong SalesForce community.
Paid vacations and additional days-off;
Education: regular tech-talks, educational courses, paid certifications, English classes;

Recruiter - Oksana Bedrii

Some elements of our recruitment process are supported by AI tools, while all candidate evaluations remain the responsibility of our recruitment team.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Client Services
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager position is a client facing role on our Client Services team. This person will own 7-10 large-scale projects related to the operational success of 829's growth marketing, digital campaigns, and content marketing. This includes helping to build and maintain new workflows for quality control and efficiency gains. They will be responsible for all aspects of client projects to ensure the marketing strategy is coordinated, aligned, and inclusive of creating project plans, deliverables, timelines and budgets. They will work on data-driven, complex projects that aid in the success of integrated digital campaigns across inbound and outbound channels. The Senior Project Manager collaborates cross-functionally with internal stakeholders both within and beyond marketing. The ideal candidate has proven experience maintaining relationships and managing projects for all client levels, complexity and sophistication.

What You'll Do

Own responsibility for all project aspects to ensure alignment and organization within the marketing department.
Ensure milestones are successfully met with the ability to anticipate workload and allocate/coordinate resources needed for project success.
Work cross-functionally to develop and manage project and campaign briefs and provide feedback on deliverables to ensure they meet the objective and raise the bar.
Manage team calendar which includes internal team status meetings, multiple weekly client status calls, and work review meetings.
Proactively contact clients to finalize project specifications and provide consultative updates throughout the project life cycle.
Own triage of new project requests, ensuring ClickUp tasks are submitted with all information & assets available ahead of scheduling.
Align with Account Managers and client to remain in full communication on the status and details of each project.
Lead weekly/daily status meetings with cross-functional departments to assure the coordination of all projects.
Lead or co-lead weekly/biweekly client meetings to define deliverable specifications and ensure strategic alignment

What You'll Bring

5-7 years of project management experience in an agency, in-house, or start-up environment.
Expertise in at least 2+ areas within the digital advertising landscape - SEM, Paid Social Ads, SEO, analytics and attribution.
2-3+ years managing paid search and social campaigns - Google Ads, Facebook, LinkedIn.
Proven track record with cross-functional collaboration and achieving high customer satisfaction.
Relevant experience within the digital advertising landscape and related technologies.
Proven ability to lead Scrum ceremonies, meeting structure, and use of industry terminology.
Excellent organizational skills and ability to grasp all department timelines that could impact project scope.
Comfort with business analytics and producing data-driven insights and reports.
Comfort managing Executive expectations and feedback.
Strong experience managing relationships/project management accounts for all client levels, complexity and sophistication.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with stakeholders at all levels.

Benefits And Perks We Provide

Remote Workplace. You have the option to work at our office in Boston or remotely in one of these states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, ID, IL, KY, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NV, NH, NJ, NY, NC, SC, OH, OK, PA, RI, TN, TX, UT, VA.
Paid Time Off. Receive generous paid vacation benefits that increase each year you’re with us, 12 Company Holidays, and Summer Fridays from Memorial Day through Labor Day.
401K + Match. 401K plan with 4% Safe Harbor employer match after one year of employment and financial literacy services provided through our retirement provider.
Life Insurance Benefit. No-cost coverage to ensure peace of mind for your family.
Short Term Disability Benefit. We've got you covered if you need to be OOO with an illness or injury that keeps you out of work.
Healthcare. Choose from several competitive healthcare plans for you and your family with 80% employer coverage for all medical and dental premiums, 100% employer coverage for vision, and the option to participate in the FSA program.
Commuter Benefits. Allocate pre-tax funds towards your commute to save up to 40% per year in transportation expenses.
Continuing Education. Access to monthly team-led webinars, exclusive 829-cohort based learning, digital course platforms, and funding opportunities to attend national conferences and events.

What We Believe

At 829 Studios, we boldly embrace diversity, inclusivity, and equal opportunity. Our goal: a team rich in backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. Why? Because inclusivity powers our brilliance and client success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, religion, creed, color, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, mental illness, age, ancestry, genetic information, military service, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Who We Are

829 Studios is a Boston-based integrated digital marketing agency with a mission to propel organizations to unlock their full potential and accomplish their most ambitious goals. We harness the power of logic with magic – a balance of data-driven strategy and brand-focused creative. We partner with diverse organizations across various industries and our client list encompasses venture-backed start-ups, publicly traded companies, non-profits, and more. By committing not only to our growth as a company, but the development of our employees and teams’, we have created a collaborative environment that fosters ingenuity and promotes diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging values within our community. 829 has been recognized as one of the nation’s top agencies by the Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Privately Held Companies, Adweek 100 Fastest-Growing Digital Agencies, Boston Business Journal's Fast 50 (Massachusetts' 50 Fastest-Growing Private Companies), HubSpot's Top Digital Agencies list, and a we are and employee-certified Great Place to Work.

Salary Range:
$75,000-$90,000

We determine compensation based on experience, demonstrated skills, and current market conditions at the time of hire to ensure fairness and consistency across roles. Actual compensation will depend on experience and may be adjusted based on skills, qualifications, and alignment with the scope and impact of the role.

to work remotely
.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with safety. It’s the constant that empowers people to confidently move forward. Our Guardian Mobile MDT and Mobilisation Solutions provide the backbone for emergency response across the UK & Europe, enabling first responders to deliver a high level of service when every second counts.

In our never-ending pursuit of "Solving for safer," we build and connect technologies that help to protect people, property, and places. By integrating critical communications, video security, and command center software, we empower emergency services with the tools needed to save lives and make everywhere safer.

We are seeking an ambitious, technically minded Systems Engineer to join our Guardian Mobile delivery team. Designed for a high-performing graduate, this role offers the opportunity to take technical ownership of complex infrastructure, systems integration, and deployment environments for strategic blue-light emergency services customers across the UK.

Bridging the gap between operational needs and enterprise architecture, you will collaborate closely with Technical Project Managers to validate system designs and execute technical configurations from contract award through to go-live. Because our products support life-critical situations, you will apply a rigorous, highly analytical engineering approach to ensure high availability and resilience across every deployment. At Motorola Solutions, we foster a people-first culture that empowers you to explore your potential, innovate what's next, and grow your career. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience is valued.

Project Governance & Delivery Leadership

Create and maintain comprehensive project plans, risk registers (RAID logs), Requests for Change (RFCs), requirements documentation, contract changes, and financial tracking
Lead and coordinate agile delivery teams, including business analysts and quality assurance engineers, from contract award through to deployment and customer sign-off
Oversee solution development and testing schedules in alignment with agreed project timelines and quality standards

Customer Requirements & Technical Strategy

Translate operational needs into clear solution specifications and system designs agreed upon with key customer stakeholders
Guide delivery strategy and communicate technical roadmaps clearly between customer leads and product development teams

Stakeholder Management & Relationship Building

Act as the primary technical and operational point of contact for strategic customers regarding deployment and integration activities
Manage customer relationships effectively through structured remote engagement and on-site visits across UK customer locations
Coordinate internal and external resources to ensure task completion within defined project scope and timeframes

Basic Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Computing, or an engineering discipline
Solid experience managing the delivery of large, complex software solutions to major enterprise or public sector customers
Ability to obtain NPPV3 and SC security clearance requiring UK residency

Technical Expertise

Agile Software Delivery to lead cross-functional agile teams and execute modern software deployment models
Technical Requirements Analysis to capture business processes and translate operational needs into technical specifications
Complex Software Architecture to evaluate infrastructure dependencies and communicate technical concepts effectively to diverse stakeholders
Language Proficiency to demonstrate an excellent command of English in written and verbal technical communications

Professional Experience

Technical Stakeholder Engagement to build trust, manage customer expectations, and lead matrixed project resources
Virtual Team Leadership to motivate and guide cross-functional project teams across engineering, QA, and business analysis
Project Governance to maintain project documentation, RAID logs, financial tracking, and change control mechanisms

Preferred Qualifications (Optional)

Agile Project Management certification (or actively working towards certification)
Direct experience with UK Fire and Rescue Control Room operations, mobilisation solutions, or Mobile Data Terminal (MDT) software

In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching and development every step of the way. Also, to reward your hard work you’ll get:

Competitive salary and bonus schemes
Two weeks additional pay per year (holiday bonus)
25 days holiday entitlement + bank holidays
Attractive defined contribution pension scheme
Private medical insurance
Employee stock purchase plan
Flexible working options
Life assurance

Career development support and wide-ranging learning opportunities
Employee health and wellbeing support (EAP, wellbeing guidance)
Carbon neutral initiatives/goals
Corporate social responsibility initiatives including support for volunteering days
Well-known companies discount scheme

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Client Services
jobs.description:
What is special about Lighthouse?

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

What’s unique about this role?

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing to a case or client annual budget, consulting clients on eDiscovery best practices, and identifying preferred paths to completing projects with a focus on reducing costs, increasing speed of delivery and use of Lighthouse technologies to drive client satisfaction. Senior PMs are responsible for planning, monitoring and managing internal and external project communications of pod members. In addition, Senior PMs provide workflow consultation, drive the development of standards and participate in the daily activities associated with providing eDiscovery support to clients.

What will this person do?

Respond to client requests and provide consultation to clients to manage the scope, execution, and overall delivery of solutions that comply with industry best practices and Lighthouse Standards.
Train and develop team members on workflows and eDiscovery best practices.
Initiate work on behalf of clients by creating work orders for tasks associated with data processing, review, and production.
Communicate expectations for scope and deadlines to internal and external stakeholders

Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you have the following:

Bachelor’s degree (Masters or JD a plus) or equivalent experience.
6+ years of work experience with at least four years of e-Discovery project management experience.5+ years of successful experience in a law department, law firm and/or a legal consulting firm or eDiscovery provider
Relativity experience required.
Excellent eDiscovery skills needed to provide consultation and creation of client and project solutions that drive the use of technology and workflows that reduce overall client costs, improve speed, and/or deliver a higher quality product.
Knowledge of or the ability to quickly acquire a deep understanding of Lighthouse workflows, internal tools and documentation necessary to act as an internal escalation resource, and ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
Strong communication skills to effectively transmit information via written (email and forms based formats ) and verbal communications to convey instructions, identify issues, propose solutions and manage conflicts between internal and external stakeholders.
Project management skills to successfully manage client relationships and execute projects to completion in order to deepen Lighthouse relationships to ensure repeat work and increased share of clients’ total spend and to gain clients’ trust as a consultant.
Flexibility and adaptability to handle a changing and growing workload.

Job Description

Please Note

Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.
This is a full-time regular role.
You will be working on a flexible hybrid schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.

The work location for this role is 483 Bay Street in Toronto until approximately late 2026, when the work location will change to the new Mississauga office at 3 Robert Speck Parkway.

Who We Are

Fidelity Investments is a world leader in mutual funds and ETF management. We pride ourselves in proprietary and disciplined research-driven investing. We offer a complete line of products and services to investors through a network of third-party brokers and financial advisors. Our primary goal is to support investment professionals as they endeavor to prepare their clients’ retirement and other significant life goals which demand focused financial management.

The role

The Project Manager (PM) is responsible to lead teams within a complex matrix environment to the successful completion of projects in support of multiple business lines, cross-functional in impact and are typically technical in nature. Depending on the type of project, it may follow the waterfall or agile methodology.

The PM is also accountable for the project team’s effectiveness by enabling the Agile methodologies to improve its practices within its frameworks.

How You’ll Make an Impact
Prepares project charter and develop detailed project plans including detailed scope statements, schedule and budget estimates and baselines, resource plans, quality plans and success criteria.
Completes all required project governance gates approval forms and presentations.
Establishes project communications and monitoring and control mechanisms.
Manages day to day project activities ensuring deliverables are met, risks are identified and assessed, and issues are managed and resolved.
Leads project team(s) in a matrix environment, clarifying roles & responsibilities, providing individual direction and feedback, and ensuring required communication support is in place.
Partners with the Project Management Office to ensure portfolio, program and project management standards, processes and procedures are adhered to.
Implements and utilizes reporting and control mechanisms, and in particular project change management approaches, to ensure the project’s triple constraints (time, cost, performance scope and quality) are well managed and status and issues are reported to sponsors, executive sponsors and senior management on a timely basis.
Ensures project post implementation reviews are planned and executed in compliance with Fidelity standards.
Works with vendors, industry firms and internal Fidelity business units to explore innovative business solutions with new technologies and alternative processes.
Participates in the preparation of RFPs, evaluate proposals, statements of work and select vendors.
In conjunction with internal partners, participate in meetings and act as the central point of contact to manage tasks, relationships, and deliverables during the lifecycle of the project.
Clear and concise Product goal definition and backlog items that the Project Team can easily understand and act upon.
Address impediments related to unclear backlog items or changing scope.
Facilitate stakeholder collaboration across business and technology teams.
Periodic advisory and coaching of the organization on Agile methodologies.
Continuous improvement reviews of the organization’s effectiveness at adopting Agile methodologies.
Ongoing support and the removal of barriers between stakeholders and Project Teams.
Periodic reporting of Project Team performance through well-defined Key Performance Indicators (e.g. burn-down / burn-up charts, velocity, etc.), value generation, and taking into consideration feedback from the Project Team, Business Owner, and key stakeholders.

University Degree or equivalent work experience or equivalent experience.
Certified Scrum Master or Professional Scrum Master certification.
Project Management Professional certification.

Minimum 5 years of experience working in a Project/Program Management and/ Scrum Master capacity.
Extensive experience in leading business and systems delivery teams using Project Management and Agile methodologies.
In-depth knowledge of Project Management and Agile frameworks, principles, and processes
Strong coaching and leadership skills.
Team focused with ability to teach teams how to be self-organized.
Adaptable to change and comfortable with transparency, inspection, and adaption.
Comfortable working with multiple teams.
Ability to build strong interpersonal relationships with cross divisional teams, senior management, and internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to work with cross divisional teams, senior management, and internal and external stakeholders.
Strong organizational and time management skills

We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional recognition. That’s why we offer a competitive compensation package
designed to support your success today—and your financial well-being tomorrow.

Job Description

Just imagine helping families around the world find more time, space, and opportunities to build, create, and play together. Then make it real.

About The Role

The new Family Impact portfolio is dedicated to strengthening family connection through play and creativity, with a particular focus on families who are under-resourced. You'll lead the design, evolution, and stewardship of family-focused programs, shaping methodology, cultivating partnerships, and ensuring evidence and insight make programs stronger over time. Working closely with the portfolio lead, regional teams, and integration partners, you'll help create meaningful outcomes for families while enabling quality delivery at scale.

Required Qualifications

Delivered family, social impact, or early childhood programs from design through implementation.
Applied human-centred design approaches to develop participant-focused programs, content, tools, or resources.
Built partnerships with technical, implementation, community, or delivery-focused organisations.
Led stakeholder engagement across multiple functions, partners, or regions.
Used impact measurement, evaluation, and learning approaches to strengthen program outcomes.
Managed program development across global and regional environments while supporting local adaptation.

Preferred Qualifications

Developed family engagement initiatives that increased participation and meaningful outcomes.
Produced sustainability, impact, or programme reporting that informed decision-making.
Contributed to social responsibility or community-based initiatives.
Supported fundraising, grant, or nonprofit partnership activities.

What You'll Build

Lead the continued development and scaling of flagship family programs across markets and regions.
Strengthen existing partner-led programs through methodology, expertise, content, resources, and platforms.
Develop relationships with implementation, technical, and evaluation partners that support impact and quality at scale.
Partner with regional Social Responsibility teams on activation, adaptation, and delivery.
Work with the Social Impact Integration team to embed evidence and learning into program design.
Support innovative concepts and emerging opportunities alongside the Incubation Manager.
Contribute to the strategy and priorities of the Family Impact Portfolio.

If you've worked in a role where you designed programs, stewarded partnerships, and used evidence to improve outcomes, you'll feel at home here. It will be key to translate ambitious ideas into practical, scalable programmes that create meaningful value for families.

Life on the team

You'll be part of a collaborative team focused on helping children and families thrive, partnering closely across regions, functions, and external organisations. Critical thinking, design thinking, storytelling, business acumen, brand awareness, social engagement, and change agility help us turn learning into action and deliver impact with purpose.

What Success Looks Like

Success means creating programs that reach more families while maintaining depth, quality, and relevance. You'll work closely with regional Social Responsibility teams, implementation partners, evaluation partners, and integration colleagues to shape the future of the portfolio. Together, you'll help strengthen family connection through play while expanding the reach and effectiveness of family-focused programs.

jobs.description:
About The Role

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Enablement Programs Lead to build and scale enablement programs that drive seller readiness, capability development, and measurable business outcomes across our Health Learning, Research & Practice (HLRP) organization. This role sits at the center of our enablement ecosystem, translating business priorities into structured, scalable solutions that improve sales execution and accelerate growth.

The ideal candidate combines strong program design and execution capabilities with a passion for learning, capability development, and cross-functional collaboration. This role is both a builder and operator—responsible for developing, codifying, and operationalizing enablement frameworks and programs that can be consistently leveraged across segments. You will work closely with Segment Enablement Leads, who own prioritization and delivery within their respective segments, to co-create solutions that can be effectively implemented and adapted to meet segment-specific needs.

This role is highly hands-on, working alongside Segment Enablement Leads and cross-functional partners to build, assemble, and operationalize programs and content—not just define frameworks. You will collaborate with Sales, Product Marketing, Sales Operations, and subject matter experts to bring together the right inputs and translate them into cohesive, high-quality enablement solutions. You will also embed modern, AI-augmented approaches to improve scalability, consistency, and impact.

Responsibilities

Build, codify, and operationalize scalable enablement programs and frameworks that drive consistent capability development across HLRP
Partner with Segment Enablement Leads to co-create solutions that can be effectively delivered and implemented within each segment
Translate business priorities into structured, repeatable programs that drive measurable behavior change and performance improvement
Develop and operationalize a common sales functional competency model/framework across HLRP, ensuring it is embedded into practical programs, content, and field execution
Define and execute a strategy for foundational enablement support aligned to the sales functional competency model/framework
Coordinate and synthesize inputs from cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Product Marketing, SMEs, Sales, Sales Operations) to build cohesive enablement programs and assets
Contribute to the development of core enablement content and materials (e.g., training modules, playbooks, learning assets) in partnership with subject matter experts
Establish and manage a structured enablement operating rhythm, including program planning, coordination, and reinforcement mechanisms
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Segment Enablement Leads, Product Marketing, and Sales Operations to ensure alignment and effective execution
Define program success metrics and evaluate effectiveness through data and field feedback
Leverage AI-enabled tools and workflows to improve scalability, consistency, and efficiency of enablement programs
Support the structuring and scalability of enablement content within platforms (e.g., Seismic) to improve accessibility and reuse

Requirements

5–8+ years of experience in sales enablement, program management, learning & development, or a related field
Proven ability to build and operationalize scalable programs, frameworks, or systems in a cross-functional environment
Strong systems thinking with the ability to translate strategy into structured, repeatable solutions
Experience partnering with Sales, Product Marketing, Sales Operations, and/or segment-aligned enablement roles in a B2B environment
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to co-create solutions and synthesize input from diverse stakeholders and subject matter experts
Familiarity with modern sales methodologies (e.g., Challenger, MEDDIC) and enablement best practices
Experience developing competency models, capability frameworks, or structured learning programs (preferred)
Experience leveraging AI or automation to enhance workflows, learning, or program scalability (preferred)
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to define success metrics and derive actionable insights from data
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant certifications a plus

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

SC Program Manager will lead projects spanning direct procurement, supply chain and operations optimization, and procurement synergy. In this role, the individual will lead multiple projects that can vary in complexity across the Regal Rexnord Enterprise. The program manager will oversee the work related to all functions over the duration of the projects. The ideal candidate will be self-driven, straightforward, able to handle multi projects at same time, and a good problem solver with common sense and a practical approach to problems.

You will bring your demonstrated history of getting quickly adapted to an unfamiliar working environment, building and leveraging relationships in a matrixed environment, working collaboratively to ensure team performance, and successfully influencing a variety of business stakeholders at all levels.

Monitor and mitigate risks with leveraging the key tasks on the critical path spanning overall project lifecycle. With priorities and sense of urgency, properly communicate and manage stakeholder’s expectations and team players’ concerns. A good problem solver to facilitate alignment when various issues that arise from stakeholders. Develop trust within the business so that where there are conflicting priorities or other issues you can ensure that all involved understand the issues and agree with the solutions put forward.

Key Responsibilities

Leverages a high level of project management skills on supply chain related outsourcing, insourcing, VA/VE, supplier resourcing, large cost out initiatives and integration projects.
Identify the project scope, objectives, schedule planning and new part qualification progress with category managers to build a healthy project pipeline for annual cost save goals by category and business unit.

Identify the risks in terms of project execution from the pipeline management perspective and escalate the potential impact with mitigation plans. Demonstrate managerial courage and leadership to challenge project priorities, resource allocation and escalate project obstacles promptly based on 80/20 principles.

Monitor and drive Open Purchase Order (PO) execution with India-based BVC suppliers supporting manufacturing plants across the USA, Mexico, Europe, and APAC regions. Proactively identify and resolve supply risks, material shortages, and delivery issues to ensure uninterrupted production and prevent line stoppages at global Regal Rexnord (RRX) facilities.
Collaborate closely with Global Category Managers, RRX manufacturing plants, India Category Managers, and Supplier Quality & Development Engineers (SQDEs) to drive the successful execution of cost-out projects. ram performance and communicate progress to leadership.

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Position Overview

You’re passionate about conversation and are seeking a role that combines your energy efficiency program experience with an opportunity to engage Indigenous communities and support their journey to reducing carbon emissions. You bring extensive project management expertise and leverage your exceptional interpersonal skills to nurture strong relationships while driving bespoke energy programs tailored to the needs of the communities you serve. Your unique skillset makes you the ideal candidate for our Indigenous Program Manager position.

In this role, you’ll lead Demand Side Management (DSM) program development, team development, marketing, and community engagement opportunities with Indigenous communities and program partners, to deliver community-grounded programs and achieve DSM Plan objectives.

In this role, you will:

Blend your strategic and analytical skills to lead and implement DSM program delivery, marketing, and community engagement with Indigenous communities and stakeholders.
Meet performance metrics and report program delivery, budget allocation, and other elements appropriately.
Collaborate with departmental partners to curate effective strategies and solutions for individual Indigenous communities.
Engage with our Indigenous customers’ housing and infrastructure teams and Indigenous stakeholder organizations to further develop trusted relationships.

What it takes:

A bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or related discipline from a recognized program, plus a minimum of five (5) years of recent, related experience with demonstrated success. Demonstrated leadership in the field of Indigenous/community/public relations, business development, or project management. A combination of education and experience may be considered.
Previous experience with delivering and communicating DSM programs, and experience working in a regulated utility would be an asset.
Exceptional leadership experience with demonstrated experience in developing high performance teams. Supervisory experience in a unionized environment is considered an asset.
Excellent project planning, development, and management skills to lead initiatives from start to finish.
Outstanding communication and professional relationship-building skills to foster strong connections with corporate departments, community organizations, and leaders.
Demonstrated Indigenous relations experience with communities in British Columbia.
Proven knowledge of customer experience and satisfaction best practices, particularly within Indigenous communities.

Job Description

Idaho National Laboratory’s National Reactor Innovation Center (NRIC) is seeking Technical Program Managers to accelerate the demonstration and deployment of advanced nuclear energy systems. As part of NRIC, you will work with reactor developers, national laboratories, federal agencies, and industry partners to overcome technical and infrastructure challenges and move innovative reactor concepts from design through demonstration.

You will lead multiple complex, rapidly evolving projects and may provide direction to subordinate project managers. You will establish program priorities, integrate project activities, monitor performance, and manage changes to deliver work safely, on schedule, and within budget. You will also coordinate the engineering, construction, modification, and operational readiness activities required to support advanced reactor testing and demonstration.

Responsibilities include directing or supporting projects involving experimental infrastructure, facility upgrades, new construction, fuel availability, testing capabilities, and demonstration sites. You will build multidisciplinary research and engineering teams, coordinate work across INL and partner organizations, and maintain productive relationships with customers and stakeholders, including the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), Department of War (DOW), other national laboratories, and private-sector reactor developers. You will communicate program performance to customers and laboratory leadership, ensure compliance with applicable requirements and standards, identify emerging needs, and develop new opportunities that advance NRIC’s mission.

Essential Job Functions And Responsibilities

Support the success of advanced reactor demonstration projects by coordinating work across national laboratories and by leading teams to design the purpose-built experimental infrastructure needed by U.S. reactor developers and work directly alongside industry partners as they demonstrate innovations in nuclear reactor design and deployment.
Work closely with other organizations, facilities, operations and business professionals to lead programmatic activities and ensure cost effective execution and completion.
Minimize the time required to build and operate novel reactor concepts.
Coordinate experimental campaigns using existing DOE facilities, develop new facilities and/or capabilities to allow testing and demonstration, ensuring the availability and production of fuel for reactor demonstrations, and preparing sites for operational demonstration reactors.

Required

Level 4: Bachelor’s degree and 9 years, or Master's degree and 6 years, or PhD and 4 years relevant experience in Nuclear, Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical Engineering, or other related degree.
Level 5: Bachelor’s degree and 14 years, or Master's degree and 8 years, or PhD and 6 years relevant experience in Nuclear, Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical Engineering, or other related degree.
Experience in systems engineering or engineering design of pilot plants and experimental facilities.
Knowledge of model-based systems and digital engineering into plant design.
Knowledge of procedures addressing requirements management, configuration management, risk management, systems analysis, verification and validation.
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy Q clearance, which requires US Citizenship.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

Experience leading projects in an environment with chemical, radiological, or other industrial hazards.
Experience as a technical lead or system architect in nuclear or process technology development.
Experience with construction project management.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, and work in an office and field/laboratory environment. The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. The job requires operation of job-related equipment and driving a vehicle. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds without assistance. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with the public is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Project Manager GRC
jobs.description:
Insight Global is looking for a for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable IT GRC professional with hands-on experience in governance, risk management, controls, compliance, and policy administration to work of biggest ontario lottery and gaming corp. The successful candidate will be a strong learner who can quickly absorb new concepts, navigate ambiguity, and drive meaningful change across the organization. They will have demonstrated experience leading medium-to-large IT initiatives, building strong stakeholder relationships, and communicating effectively with audiences ranging from practitioners and managers to senior executives. While technical GRC expertise is important, we place equal value on learning agility, execution capability, and the ability to influence and collaborate across teams. The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in IT controls and risk management, with familiarity with industry frameworks such as COBIT and NIST. Working knowledge of COBIT 2019 is highly desirable, but not mandatory.

What are the biggest GRC challenges you're trying to solve right now?

Our biggest challenge is moving from a collection of governance, risk, compliance, controls, and audit activities into a truly integrated GRC operating model. Today, many of the capabilities exist, but they're not always connected in a way that provides end-to-end visibility and accountability.
We're focused on strengthening the governance framework, modernizing our controls environment, improving traceability between risks and controls, and creating stronger alignment between IT, Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Controls, and Internal Audit. Ultimately, we want GRC to become an enabler of decision making, not just a compliance function.

What would success look like in the first year?

I would expect the incumbent to:
Become a trusted advisor to stakeholders across IT and enterprise functions.
Help operationalize and mature our IT Governance framework.
Play a key role in the IT Governance awareness campaign planned for early next year
Drive meaningful progress on the controls modernization program phase 2 (Phase 1 is almost complete).
Establish stronger integration between risk management, controls, audit findings, and compliance activities.
Improve IT policy administration and governance processes.
Increase visibility into our IT control environment through better reporting, ownership, and metrics.

Which initiatives would be the highest priority for this role?

The top priorities would be:
Controls Modernization (phase 2)

Rationalizing and improving our control environment.
Strengthening risk-to-control mapping.
Identifying key controls and improving control ownership.

IT Governance Framework

Supporting rollout, adoption, and ongoing maturity of the governance framework.
Managing the governance awareness campaign
Enhancing governance processes, accountabilities, and decision structures.

Risk and Controls Integration

Aligning IT risk management more closely with controls, attestations, audit findings, and enterprise risk processes by working with other teams

IT Policy Administration

Improving policy lifecycle management, governance, and compliance monitoring.

How mature is the current IT GRC program?

I would describe the program as being in the developing-to-defined stage of maturity.
We have many foundational elements in place, including governance initiatives, risk and compliance activities, controls, policy management, attestation processes, and relationships with enterprise assurance functions. However, we're working to bring these capabilities together into a more cohesive and integrated operating model.
The opportunity for the successful candidate is that they won't be building from scratch, but they will play a significant role in shaping the next phase of maturity and helping move the organization toward a more coordinated and proactive GRC model.

If you could solve one GRC problem this year, what would it be?

If I had to choose one, it would be creating end-to-end alignment between governance, risk, controls, compliance, and audit activities.

The nature of the role

This is not a maintenance role. It's a transformation role. The incumbent will have the opportunity to help shape the future state of IT GRC, influence enterprise-wide governance practices, modernize the controls environment, and build stronger integration between risk, compliance, audit, and governance. The successful candidate will have a visible impact on how IT is governed and how risk-informed decisions are made across the organization.

Some additional comments

I'm not necessarily looking for the strongest IT GRC specialist on the market. I'm looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, eager to learn, adaptable, and capable of driving meaningful change, while bringing solid hands-on GRC experience. The ideal candidate can quickly absorb new concepts, lead medium-to-large initiatives, build strong relationships across the organization, and communicate with confidence at all levels, from practitioners and managers to senior leadership.
While technical GRC knowledge is important, mindset, learning agility, execution capability, and stakeholder management are key to success in this role. The incumbent should have a strong foundation in IT controls, risk management, and compliance, and be familiar with recognized industry frameworks and practices such as COBIT and NIST. Working knowledge of COBIT 2019 would be highly desirable, but it is not a mandatory requirement.

Responsable de processus d'affaires

Europe — Flexible location across European countries

organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.

Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.

Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries through the change management process.
Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.

You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026
Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025)

Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC

This is a highly strategic, customer-facing role for operators who thrive at the intersection of technology, product, and execution.

You will lead implementations from initial discovery through production launch, helping customers redesign business processes around AI while ensuring successful technical delivery.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to executives, operators, and technical teams, helping customers define requirements, scope solutions, drive adoption, and realize measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, working directly with customers, and owning outcomes from strategy through execution, this role offers an opportunity to operate at the center of one of the fastest-growing categories in AI.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end customer deployments from discovery through production launch, owning project execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and successful delivery.
Partner directly with customers to understand business goals, gather requirements, and translate them into scalable AI-powered workflows.
Become a subject matter expert in Retell's platform, voice AI best practices, and LLM prompting techniques.
Design conversational workflows, automation strategies, and deployment architectures that deliver measurable business outcomes.
Build prototypes, validate use cases, and guide customers through implementation tradeoffs and optimization opportunities.
Act as a trusted advisor to executives and operational leaders, helping them identify opportunities to leverage AI across their organizations.
Lead discovery sessions, business process reviews, and strategic planning conversations with customer stakeholders.
Build ROI models and business cases that quantify the impact of AI automation and help customers prioritize initiatives.
Partner closely with Sales during pre-sales engagements, solution scoping, and customer presentations.
Coordinate across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to unblock deployments and ensure customer success.
Communicate project progress, risks, recommendations, and next steps clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Translate customer feedback into actionable product recommendations and help shape the future direction of the Retell platform.
Develop repeatable deployment playbooks, best practices, and frameworks that enable customers to deploy voice AI successfully at scale.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF YOU

Have exceptional communication skills and can quickly build credibility with executives, operators, and technical teams.
Enjoy acting as a trusted advisor and influencing decisions across multiple stakeholders.
Have strong product intuition and enjoy understanding customer workflows, identifying pain points, and designing scalable solutions.
Can balance technical implementation details with business outcomes and strategic thinking.
Thrive in ambiguous environments and enjoy creating structure where none exists.
Have a strong ownership mentality and are willing to do whatever is necessary to drive successful outcomes.
Enjoy managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Are highly organized, execution-oriented, and able to move initiatives from concept to production.
Have experience in deployment, implementation, solutions consulting, product management, forward deployed engineering, strategic consulting, or other customer-facing technology roles.
Have experience writing requirements, implementation plans, PRDs, or project specifications.
Have experience building business cases, performing ROI analysis, or conducting value-based solution scoping.
Are excited about AI, LLMs, voice technology, and helping customers adopt cutting-edge technologies.
Enjoy learning new systems, becoming a domain expert, and solving difficult customer problems.
Are comfortable navigating technical conversations even if you are not a full-time engineer.
Want to operate at the intersection of technology, product, strategy, and customer success at one of the fastest-growing AI companies.

JOB DETAILS

Cash: 170k - 260k
Equity: Equity Provided
Location: Redwood City, CA, US - relocation provided
US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H1B/H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, F-1 (OPT/CPT).

Other Benefits

100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance
$70/day DoorDash credit for unlimited breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
$200/month wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, etc.)
$300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.)
$75/month phone bill reimbursement
$50/month internet reimbursement

Compensation Philosophy

Best Offer Upfront: Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed.
Top 1% Talent: Above-market pay (top 5 percentile) to attract exceptional builders.
High Ownership: Small teams, >$1M revenue/employee, and significant equity.
Performance-Based: Offers tied to interview performance, not experience or past salaries.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

Talent Screen (15 min): An introductory conversation with our recruiting team to learn more about your background, experience, and interest in Retell.
Functional Interview (45 min): A practical discussion focused on problem-solving, communication, customer-facing judgment, and how you approach ambiguous business and technical challenges.
Hiring Manager Interview (30 min): A conversation focused on past experiences, ownership, stakeholder management, and working in high-growth environments.
Final Interviews (3 hrs): A series of collaborative interviews with members of our Product, Engineering, and GTM teams. We'll explore how you think through customer problems, work cross-functionally, communicate with stakeholders, and execute in fast-paced environments.

Responsibilities

Project Management: Lead analytics projects from scope to delivery, ensuring timelines, quality standards, and stakeholder expectations are met.

Desired Skills  

Proven success building and leading analytics teams. Leadership & Team Management: Demonstrated ability to develop talent and lead cross-functional teams. Statistical Analysis & Data Mining: Proficiency in statistical methods and techniques to extract insights from complex datasets, including expertise with AI for market & business analysis. Advanced Analytics: Deep knowledge of analytics methodologies, tools, and technologies, including predictive modeling and segmentation. Programming & Database Management: Strong skills in the Microsoft environment (e.g., Fabric, Azure), Python, R, or SQL, with experience in querying and managing large databases. Data Visualization: Expertise in Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools to create impactful visualizations. Critical Thinking & Problem-Solving: Ability to approach challenges analytically and recommend data-driven actions. Strategic Thinking: Experience aligning analytics initiatives with business goals and driving measurable impact. Project Management: Skilled in managing multiple projects with competing priorities and stakeholders. Communication & Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to translate complex data into clear insights and influence decision-making across departments.

Minimum Education

Preferred Education   

Masters Degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Marketing, or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience  

8 years’ progressive experience working in the business analytics, market research and/or competitive intelligence environment.

Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties.
Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner.
Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product.
Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required.
Foster positive work relationships.
Comply with all firm policies and practices.
Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed.
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. jobs.title: Security Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Altruist

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.
We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

About the position

Altruist is in the midst of an exciting phase and we’re excited to hire a Security Operations Manager to lead detection, response, and security monitoring for a self-clearing broker-dealer. You’ll build and lead the team and the 24x7 program that keeps our platform — and our advisors’ clients — safe.

This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.

What you’ll do

Lead, mentor, and grow the security operations / detection & response team, setting priorities and career paths.
Own our 24x7 security monitoring strategy across our managed detection & response provider
Run the incident response program end to end — from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
Define and report on SecOps metrics and SLAs (MTTD/MTTR, alert quality, coverage) to security and executive leadership.
Mature our detection engineering, threat-intelligence ingestion, and response automation (SOAR) capabilities.
Drive regular tabletop and purple-team exercises and partner with Cloud, IT, and Engineering to close gaps surfaced by monitoring.
Own the day-to-day operation and roadmap of the security operations tooling stack.

What you’ll bring

Experience -
6+ years in security operations, including 2+ years leading or managing a SOC or detection & response team:
Hands-on incident response and investigations in a cloud-first environment
Depth with SIEM (Datadog/Splunk), EDR/MDR (CrowdStrike/SentinelOne), and cloud telemetry (AWS)
Experience managing an MDR/MSSP and/or IR retainer relationship
Strong ability to lead through influence and operate with urgency
Education -
A B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Information Security or relevant experience
Technical aptitude -
You’re technologically savvy and comfortable across modern cloud and detection stacks (i.e., AWS, Kubernetes, SIEM query languages, detection-as-code, Terraform, etc.)
Ownership -
The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable
Superb communication -
Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others.
Resilience -
We’re inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way.
Assurance -
Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives.
Creative problem solving -
Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You’re instinctually creative with your approach in finding solutions to roadblocks.

Bonus points if you bring

Experience working in regulated environments (SEC/FINRA, fintech, or financial services)
Experience building or standing up a 24x7 SOC or transitioning to managed detection & response
Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA)

San Francisco, CA salary range

$203,000 - $275,000 USD

What we bring

Attracting and retaining top-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best.
Stunning, amenity-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity.
Competitive total compensation.
Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO).
401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting.
16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment.
Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L&D budget allocation for each employee.
Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.).
Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home-purchasing preparedness, etc.).
One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries).

Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst

HYBRI- MUST WORK EST( Eastern Standard Time, United States)

About Tillster

Headquartered in the USA, Tillster is the global leader in digital ordering and customer engagement solutions. For over a decade we have developed revolutionary self-service, ordering and payments solutions – for mobile, tablet, online, kiosk, call center, and more – creating personalized interactions based on consumer preferences, language, and currency. Our platform is compatible with 15+ unique POS systems, representing over 90% coverage in multi-unit restaurants. We offer one platform: one scalable, enterprise class solution – to create world-class digital engagement solutions. Our mission and passion are one in the same: Empower restaurants and consumers to engage and transact anywhere, anytime, and from any device - one consumer at a time, one order at a time, billions of times over. In doing so, together we are transforming e-commerce in restaurants and making the till grow for Tillster and our customers.

Are you a passionate data analytics with a knack for data?

Job Duties

Analytics & Insight Delivery

Own the end-to-end delivery of complex analytical initiatives — from framing the business question and scoping the analysis through execution, presentation, and follow-through on stakeholder action. Do not wait to be asked; proactively surface KPI trends, anomalies, opportunities, and risks before stakeholders encounter them.
Support ad-hoc analysis for Tillster customers, executives, and internal stakeholders — going beyond data retrieval to provide interpretive framing and actionable recommendations with a clear point of view.
Operate as a trusted analytics advisor to Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations. Challenge assumptions in business requests where data tells a different story. Translate complex findings into decision-relevant narratives.
Design and support A/B test experiments with statistically valid methodology — including hypothesis definition, sample sizing, success and guardrail metric selection, and results analysis. Communicate findings clearly to Product and Marketing stakeholders.

Google Analytics & Data Collection

Act as the team's primary Google Analytics subject matter expert. Own GA4 reporting, custom dimensions and metrics design, tracking plan validation, and GA-to-warehouse integration. Advise on tagging strategy for new product features and platform launches in partnership with the Lead MarTech Solutions Architect.
BI Development & Semantic Layer
Design, build, and maintain high-performing Explores and dashboards in Looker for business stakeholders including Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations — owning deliverables end-to-end with minimal re-work.
Develop LookML for owned domains to a high quality standard — including complex dimensions, measures, derived tables, and Explore configurations. Ensure all LookML is documented, tested, and consistent with organisation-wide semantic layer standards.
Ensure metric definitions in owned domains are canonical, unambiguous, and consistent with the definitions governed by the Analytics Engineering team. Flag and resolve discrepancies between business intent and semantic layer implementation.
Expand self-service analytics capabilities — enabling non-technical users across Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to answer their own questions independently, reducing ad-hoc request volume to the team. Target coverage across ≥2 new business units per half-year.
Proactively maintain the accuracy and consistency of production Explores and dashboards as underlying data warehouse structures change. Identify discrepancies before stakeholders encounter them.

Data Quality & Platform Collaboration

Own the accuracy and freshness of all data products in scope. Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues — with root-cause evidence — and partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers to resolve upstream problems promptly.
Write high-quality, performant SQL — including complex window functions and CTEs — and collaborate with Data Engineers on query optimisation, compute cost efficiency, and derived table design for owned analytical workloads.
Collaborate with Analytics Engineers on LookML architecture and semantic layer design for owned domains — providing analytical requirements that inform model design and validating that data models correctly reflect business logic.
Partner with the Senior BI & AI Analyst on customer analytics definitions for segmentation, LTV, and churn use cases. Consume ML model outputs from the Data Science team and surface them accurately in dashboards and analytical narratives.
Understand the structure of data pipelines feeding owned dashboards sufficiently to diagnose data freshness and quality issues, escalate to the correct team, and communicate resolution timelines to stakeholders.

Standards, Mentorship & Team Development

Own coding standards and analytical best practices for the team — including SQL style guides, LookML conventions, documentation requirements, and PR review processes. Conduct structured code reviews that are substantive, consistent, and designed to build capability in Junior Analysts.
Mentor Junior Data Analysts through paired analysis, direct feedback, and structured review. Track improvement over time. Escalate development needs or blockers to the Manager.
Build and contribute reusable assets to shared team libraries — including SQL query patterns, LookML components, analysis frameworks, and documentation templates — reducing time-to-delivery for the entire team, not just own work.
Contribute to at least one standards update, governance policy, or best-practice guide per year.

AI-Augmented Analytics & Self-Serve Agent Development

Apply LLM and AI tools (Gemini, GPT-4, Cortex Analyst, or equivalent) hands-on to accelerate analytics workflows — including automated insight narration, anomaly detection and explanation, and AI-assisted dashboard annotation. Practical delivered experience required; theoretical familiarity is not sufficient.
Design and build self-serve analytics agents that enable non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Account Management to query data and surface insights in natural language — without raising tickets or requiring analyst intervention. Own the full lifecycle from prompt design through output validation and iteration.
Configure Cortex Analyst or equivalent AI-assisted BI platforms to extend self-service beyond traditional dashboard interaction — including semantic model templates and YAML definitions that produce accurate, governed responses to unstructured business questions.
Define quality standards for AI-generated analytical outputs — including accuracy validation, hallucination detection, and a review process before AI-generated insights are shared externally or with executives.
Prototype and propose AI tooling that reduces repetitive analytical work for the team. Present prototypes to the Manager with a clear build-vs-buy recommendation and documented lessons learned that contribute to the team's shared AI analytics playbook.

Skills Required With Years Of Experience

Core Technical Skills (5-7 years total experience)

SQL & Data Analysis
- 4-5 years

Advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization)
Complex analytical queries and performance tuning

Business Intelligence Tools
- 3-4 years

Looker expert (LookML development, Explores, dashboards)
Data visualization and self-service analytics design

Google Analytics
- 2-3 years

GA4 implementation, configuration, and reporting
Tracking strategy and warehouse integration

Python/Programming
- 1-2 years (preferred)

Data manipulation and automation
Version control (Git) and code review

Statistical & Analytical Skills (3-5 Years)

A/B Testing & Experimentation
- 2-3 years

Experimental design and statistical testing
Hypothesis formulation and results interpretation

Statistical Analysis
- 3-4 years

Descriptive and inferential statistics
Trend analysis and anomaly detection

AI & Emerging Technologies (1-2 years)

AI-Augmented Analytics
- 1-2 years

Hands-on LLM usage (GPT-4, Gemini, Cortex Analyst)
AI agent development and prompt engineering
AI output validation and quality standards

Business & Communication Skills (4-6 Years)

Stakeholder Management
- 4-5 years

Cross-functional collaboration (Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering)
Executive communication and presentation
Trusted advisor relationships

Business Analytics
- 3-4 years

Customer analytics (segmentation, LTV, churn)
KPI development and metric definition
Translating business questions to analytical frameworks

Leadership & Mentorship (2-3 years)

Team Leadership
- 2-3 years

Mentoring junior analysts
Code review and standards enforcement
Building team best practices and documentation

Project Management
- 3-4 years

End-to-end analytical project ownership
Managing multiple concurrent initiatives
Proactive insight delivery

Thriving at Tillster

As a member of Tillster, you will embody our core values:

Put Customers First: Prioritize the needs and satisfaction of our customers in all decisions and actions appropriate to Tillster’s stage of development, resources, and stated goals.
Collaborate: Work together effectively, leveraging diverse perspectives to achieve common goals.
