jobs.title: Distribution Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

The Distribution Operations Analyst transforms distribution, inventory, labor, productivity, and operational data into clear insights and actionable recommendations that improve service, efficiency, accuracy, and execution across the distribution operation. This role develops and maintains reporting, dashboards, forecasts, and analytical tools; identifies trends and root causes; and partners with Distribution leadership and cross-functional teams to solve operational business problems. The Analyst uses data, automation, and company-approved analytical and generative AI tools to improve visibility, support decision-making, and identify practical solutions while maintaining data security, accuracy, confidentiality, and appropriate human review. The Distribution Operations Analyst reports directly to the Vice President of Distribution.

Duties And Responsibilities

Support the “Cavender’s Culture” and drive our Mission, Vision, and Values.
Partner with Distribution leadership to translate operational questions and business needs into structured analysis, clear insights, and practical recommendations.
Analyze distribution center performance using productivity, labor, inventory accuracy, order flow, throughput, service level, receiving, picking, packing, shipping, and other key operating metrics.
Identify trends, outliers, risks, and opportunities; perform root-cause and variance analysis to help explain performance drivers and determine where operational focus or corrective action is needed.
Build and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, and planning tools that provide timely visibility into distribution performance and business trends for the Vice President of Distribution and other operational leaders.
Support labor and productivity analysis, including workload trends, staffing needs, resource allocation, and opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
Perform inventory and process analysis to support inventory integrity, order accuracy, flow of merchandise, and effective use of distribution center resources.
Use Microsoft Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot, Power BI, SQL, and other approved analytical tools to combine data, automate repeatable processes, improve reporting efficiency, and reduce manual work.
Assist with the development and maintenance of analytical models and tools used for scenario planning, process improvement, operational initiatives, and evaluation of changes within the distribution center.
Use company-approved enterprise generative AI tools to synthesize information, support analysis, compare scenarios, and develop solution options; validate AI-generated outputs against source data and business context before use.
Protect confidential and proprietary information and follow company data governance, security, and responsible AI practices when using analytical, automation, and generative AI tools.
Partner cross-functionally with Store Operations, Merchandising, Finance, Information Technology, Loss Prevention, and other teams to connect distribution performance with broader business needs and identify opportunities for improvement.
Prepare clear reports and presentations that communicate performance, key findings, business implications, and recommended next steps to Distribution leadership.
Ensure distribution data, reporting, and analytical outputs are maintained with a high level of accuracy, accessibility, consistency, and appropriate internal controls.

Qualifications And Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Business Analytics, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
1–3 years of experience in operations analytics, distribution, supply chain, business intelligence, financial analysis, or a related analytical role; distribution or retail experience preferred.
Demonstrated ability to analyze operational performance, identify trends and underlying drivers, and translate data into practical recommendations.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, and reporting.
Working to intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Power Query, Power Pivot, and Power BI, including the ability to build or maintain dashboards and recurring reporting solutions.
Working knowledge of SQL or experience querying, validating, or combining data from multiple sources preferred.
Working knowledge of enterprise generative AI tools and the ability to use AI responsibly for research, analysis, problem solving, and solution development while validating outputs for accuracy and relevance.
General understanding of distribution, supply chain, inventory, labor, productivity, and performance measurement concepts.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to operational leaders and business partners.
Based onsite in Wilmer, TX.

Preferred Skills

Strong operational business acumen and curiosity about how labor, inventory, order flow, productivity, service, and cost connect within a distribution environment.
Problem-solving mindset with the ability to move beyond reporting what happened to helping explain why it happened and what actions may improve results.
Experience working with warehouse management, inventory, labor management, order fulfillment, transportation, or other distribution-related data sources.
Experience using automation or AI-assisted workflows to improve analytical quality, speed, and consistency.
Ability to handle confidential materials and matters with maximum discretion.
Attention to detail, with an eye for numbers and the ability to identify outliers, inconsistencies, and unusual patterns quickly.
Project management, prioritization, and organizational skills with the ability to manage recurring reporting and analytical assignments in a fast-moving environment.

The Data Analyst collaborates with key organizational leaders, including the C-suite, to deliver cohesive, rigorous, and insightful reporting tools and in-depth analyses that facilitate data-driven decision making. Works collaboratively with internal teams to solve cross-functional business challenges and provide key insights that drive improvement for both the business and its customers.
Translates analyses into actionable, data-backed recommendations and summaries of expected results.
Analyzes operational initiatives to measure their effectiveness and impact on key performance indicators (KPIs), enables in-depth understanding of existing performance, and recommends process optimizations based on a data-driven analysis of expected results

Proficiency in data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, DAX, Python, and/or R with advanced skill in Excel.
Strong data visualization skills using Power BI and/or Tableau as well as for storytelling in presentations of results to organizational leadership.
Excellent analytical and statistical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.

Experience analyzing and reporting data to identify issues, trends, or opportunities in a meaningful way to a variety of audiences.
Experience collaborating with business unit leaders for requirements gathering and refinement of key business needs and questions.
Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
Self-starter with strong organizational and time management skills, self-directed and able to handle multiple priorities with demanding timeframes.
Ability to guide and support others through collaboration, including assisting teammates and contributing to shared processes, to foster a high-quality, team-oriented environment that drives results.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
GTM Operations & Strategy at MongoDB is a global team of builders and innovators focused on unleashing MongoDB’s sales greatness by pairing world‑class analytics with scalable operations. Within GTM Operations, the GTM Intelligence – Applied Science team turns complex GTM data into tools, models, and insights that help our sales organization make better, faster decisions across our people, segmentation, territory design, forecasting, and account prioritization.

As a Senior Analyst on the Applied Science team, you will own high‑impact analytical workstreams end‑to‑end: from problem framing with senior GTM stakeholders, to data engineering and model design, through to productionalized workflows, dashboards, and executive‑ready narratives that drive concrete changes in the field. This role is based in Dublin, Ireland and supports a global stakeholder set across regions and GTM functions.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.

What You’ll Do

Translate GTM questions into analytical projects
Partner with GTM Ops, Sales Strategy & Planning, Sales Leadership, and Central Analytics to scope problems, define success criteria, and prioritize work across areas like segmentation, territory design, account prioritization, and pipeline/forecast health.
Structure ambiguous questions into hypotheses, analytical plans, and clear recommendations for senior stakeholders (SVPs, RVPs, functional leaders).
Design and build scalable analytics & models
Develop and maintain statistical and machine learning models (e.g., NARR prediction, deal qualification, account momentum, workload identification) that inform forecast expectations, territory assignments, and deal prioritization.
Engineer robust data pipelines and features (SQL/Python) on top of our GTM data stack (Salesforce, product usage, call transcripts, marketing signals, etc.) in partnership with data and platform teams.
Own core GTM analytics assets
Contribute to flagship programs such as Forecasting 3.0 / Atlas Forecasting Calculator, Customer 360 Revamp, GTM Metrics 3.0, and territory optimization initiatives, ensuring they are statistically sound, explainable, and operationally durable.
Build and govern self-serve analytics assets (e.g., Sigma workbooks, curated datasets) that allow GTM stakeholders to answer their own questions safely and consistently.
Turn analysis into decisions and change
Deliver concise, executive‑ready narratives (memos, scorecards, and QBR/MBR content) that highlight trade‑offs and explicit recommendations, not just data and charts.
Run stakeholder working sessions to align on scenarios, validate model outcomes, and embed recommendations into operating rhythms (e.g., segmentation reviews, annual planning, forecast calls).
Advance our GTM data & AI foundations
Help shape and exploit new GTM data sources such as call transcript modeling, workload inference, and account intelligence to unlock novel scoring and routing use cases.
Partner with Central Analytics and GTM Tech on best practices for testing, monitoring, documentation, and change management for GTM models and analytics products.
Coach, document, and uplevel the org
Create clear documentation, playbooks, and training to help other analysts and GTM stakeholders understand and safely use the models, tools, and datasets you own.
Contribute to a strong culture of technical rigor, peer review, and knowledge sharing within Sales Intelligence and the broader GTM Operations community.

What We’re Looking For

Experience

~4–7+ years in analytics, sales operations, data science, or strategy/consulting roles supporting B2B or SaaS go‑to‑market teams (or equivalent high‑impact analytical experience).
Demonstrated track record owning complex analytics projects end‑to‑end (from scoping through production deployment and stakeholder adoption), ideally in forecasting, segmentation/territory design, or account/deal scoring domains.
Experience working directly with senior commercial stakeholders (e.g., Sales/GTM leaders) and turning analysis into concrete decisions and measurable business impact.

Technical Skills

Advanced SQL and strong Python (or equivalent) for data wrangling, feature engineering, and statistical / ML modeling.
Comfort working with large, messy datasets spanning CRM (Salesforce), product usage, and marketing/sales engagement tools.
Experience with at least one modern BI / analytics environment (e.g., Sigma, Looker, Tableau) and building self‑serve, governed assets for business users.
Solid grounding in statistical thinking (sampling, backtesting, lift/impact measurement) and model validation practices.

Problem‑Solving & Communication

Ability to decompose ambiguous business questions into structured analytical plans, with clear assumptions, risks, and trade‑offs.
Strong written and verbal communication: you can explain complex models and data decisions in simple, GTM‑friendly language and build trust with non‑technical stakeholders.
Bias toward action and ownership: you are comfortable making recommendations under uncertainty and iterating as new data arrives.

Nice to Have

Prior experience in Sales Operations / Revenue Operations or GTM Strategy at a high‑growth SaaS company.
Experience with forecasting and timeseries models, or commercial applications of NLP / LLMs (e.g., call transcript analytics, opportunity notes analysis).
Familiarity with MongoDB’s ecosystem (Atlas, GTM motions, sales process) or similar modern cloud data platforms.
Experience contributing to cross‑functional programs such as Customer 360, self‑serve analytics initiatives, or GTM data/metrics standardization.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Why work at Villanova?

Join a mission-driven organization. Since Villanova University’s founding in 1842, we have been inspired by the values of truth, unity, and love, and are a community dedicated to service to others.
Villanova has been included among the nation’s best colleges and universities. VU’s inclusion again in U.S. News & World Report’s 2025 “Best Colleges” rankings is another indication of the University’s continued prominence and forward momentum.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Program Manager, Human Resources role within the North America Service Business division involves leading and coordinating cross-functional HR programs and initiatives that support employee engagement, organizational effectiveness, talent development, and business goals. The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, data-driven, and comfortable managing multiple priorities from planning through execution.

Role And Responsibilities

Role and Responsibilities

Lead the planning, implementation, and delivery of HR programs and strategic initiatives.
Partner with HR leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to define goals, timelines, milestones, and success metrics.
Manage project plans, budgets, risks, dependencies, and communications.
Coordinate initiatives across areas such as talent management, employee engagement, onboarding, learning and development, performance management, and HR operations.
Develop processes, tools, and documentation to improve the efficiency and consistency of HR programs.
Track program performance and provide regular updates, insights, and recommendations to HR leadership.
Analyze HR data and metrics to evaluate program effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
Facilitate meetings, working sessions, and stakeholder communications to maintain alignment and accountability.
Identify potential risks or roadblocks and develop solutions to keep programs on track.
Support change management and employee communications related to new HR programs, policies, and processes.
Ensure HR programs are implemented consistently and in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements.

Continuously evaluate programs and recommend enhancements based on employee feedback, business needs, and performance data.

Skills And Qualifications

Skills and Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field.
Minimum 6 years of experience in program management, project management, HR, or a related function.
HR or program/project management certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PMP, or equivalent.
Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.
Experience with change management, employee experience, or organizational development programs.
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and presentations for senior leadership.
Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Who We Are

At EY, we’re more than just a professional services firm. We’re a global network united by a shared purpose to build a better working world. We empower our people to challenge the status quo, embrace innovation, and deliver lasting impact for our clients and communities.

Client Technology Activation & Commercials brings together capabilities that help EY identify market demand, shape and commercialize technology offerings, support product delivery, and strengthen customer adoption and outcomes. The function operates in support of Clients & Industries, Applied Innovation, Commercials and Customer Success, with a shared focus on consistent delivery, clear governance, commercial readiness and measurable value.

You’ll also find a culture that prioritizes learning, innovation, collaboration and growth, providing you with the tools, support and freedom to thrive and shape your career.

The Opportunity

The Program Manager will provide dedicated support to the CTO & CT Commercials Leader, helping translate strategic priorities into coordinated execution across the organization. The role will manage key operational requirements, coordinate cross-functional priorities, drive follow-through, and support the effective delivery of strategic initiatives and organizational capabilities.

This role requires a proactive, highly organized and strategically minded individual who can operate with discretion, work effectively with senior stakeholders, and bring structure and clarity to complex priorities. The Program Manager will serve as an integrator, advisor and execution partner, connecting work across teams, establishing effective operating rhythms, identifying risks and dependencies, and ensuring commitments progress from decision through execution.

Key Responsibilities

Anticipate priorities and translate leadership direction into clear actions, owners, timelines and expected outcomes.
Manage key operational requirements and establish effective operating rhythms, including leadership agendas, business reviews, decision forums, planning cycles and follow-up mechanisms.
Coordinate cross-functional priorities and dependencies to support integrated execution across the organization.
Ideate and drive strategic initiatives from planning through implementation, maintaining visibility into milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and outcomes.
Prepare executive briefings, presentations, talking points, reports and analysis to support effective leadership discussions and decision-making.
Capture key decisions and stakeholder inputs, track commitments and actions, raise barriers and ensure timely follow-through and accountability.
Support the development and implementation of organizational capabilities, governance, processes, tools and ways of working that improve effectiveness.
Partner with Finance, Talent, Operations, Communications and other enabling functions to coordinate business and organizational requirements.
Provide clear visibility into progress against strategic priorities, including risks, dependencies, capacity requirements and matters requiring leadership attention.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, coordination and operational efficiency.
Act as a trusted thought partner to the CTO & CT Commercials Leader, bringing perspective, insight and constructive challenge to support stronger outcomes.

Skills & Attributes For Success

Strong program management and organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to move complex priorities from strategy through execution.
Background in driving enterprise scale transformation
Strong strategy, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights, recommendations and actions -ability to translate vision into execution
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and the ability to engage and influence executives and senior stakeholders.
Proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities within a fast-paced and highly matrixed environment.
Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to maintain a broader strategic and organizational perspective.
Demonstrated discretion and ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.
Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across diverse teams, cultures and working styles.
High degree of accountability, adaptability and follow-through.
Confidence to appropriately challenge assumptions and surface issues requiring leadership attention.
Demonstrates and maintains the technical and functional proficiency required for the role and takes ownership of continuous learning and upskilling to keep skills current and aligned with evolving technology, role and business requirements.
Commitment to continuous improvement and effective use of AI and technology to improve productivity and effectiveness.

Ideally, the Candidate Will Have

Significant experience in program or portfolio management, business operations, strategy, transformation or a related discipline.
Have a passion and love for transformation and innovation
Experience supporting a senior executive and coordinating priorities across a complex, global and matrixed organization.
Demonstrated success establishing governance and operating rhythms, managing interdependent workstreams, and driving execution against strategic priorities.
Experience preparing executive briefings, reports, presentations and decision-support materials.
Experience within technology delivery, commercialization, innovation, customer success or a professional services environment is preferred.
Ability to quickly learn EY’s operating structure, strategic priorities and leadership dynamics.

Job Requirements

Education

Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.

Experience

Approximately 8–10 years of experience in a medium to large environment, performing business analysis, business development and project management.
Direct experience managing medium to complex activities, such as business development and application development or deployment.
Project management training and practical application, along with business analysis, business development or relationship management experience, are preferred.

Certification Requirements

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is strongly preferred.

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:

New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $167,100 to $300,900
Bay Area California offices – $174,100 to $313,400
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $139,300 to $275,800

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

Project Managers assist with the management of eDiscovery cases by driving work through various operational departments to meet litigation project requests. This includes creating work orders for tasks associated with data intake, culling, processing, hosting and production and completing quality checks to ensure the accuracy and completeness of work product before it is released to clients.

Maintain a good understanding of eDiscovery, market competitors and the tools used to support the industry
Develop a thorough understanding of Lighthouse workflows, critical paths needed to progress work through the system and tools used by Lighthouse to manage workflows
Communicate proper expectations for scope and deadlines to internal and external stakeholders
Manage the pod’s work request queue
Participate in process improvement initiatives as identified by pod leaders
Perform other related duties as assigned

Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you have the following:

Bachelor’s degree (Masters or JD a plus)
4+ years of work experience with at least two years of eDiscovery experience
Relativity experience required.
PMP certification a plus
Strong analytical and logical skills
Strong project management skills including the ability to interpret a variety of instructions provided in written or oral form
Flexibility and adaptability to handle a changing and growing workload

Work Environment and Physical Demands

jobs.title: Roofing Project Manager - Commercial Production Roofing
jobs.description:
SUMMARY:

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for effectively managing commercial construction projects in the low-slope roofing category including sheet metal installation and masonry restoration (as needed) by the scope of the contract.
Additionally, you will be responsible for understanding your assigned contracts, planning & phasing work, managing superintendents, managing a budget and costs for the project, ordering and timing material deliveries, analyzing job-cost reports, providing estimates of costs to complete the project, as well as change order cost estimation.
You will use your commercial roofing management and safety knowledge proactively as a champion for safety company-wide by demonstrating best practices, and by working with the President on safety training and strategic initiatives.
As a Project Manager ,you will learn our process and technology, set an example for professionalism and leadership within the operations department by taking ownership of your projects as capital investments, and help the company continually move towards growth and profitability goals.
QUALIFICATIONS
:

Location: Baltimore, MD Area

Position Type: Full-Time (Onsite)

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager (DOT)

Compliance: Coordinate with minority and small business enterprises (MBE) to ensure participation goals are met or exceeded.

Education & Experience

Degree: Bachelor s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or Civil Engineering Technology (or an equivalent combination of education and experience).

jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

Serves in a Project Management role within the Mid-Atlantic Water Ecosystem and Resiliency Group to p rovide high level technical assistance and guidance in water resources engineering work processes, due diligence, site assessment, impact assessment, and design justification. Tasks may include the design and development of processes and operating strategies related to river/stream/habitat restoration and fish passage, hydrologic/hydraulic modeling, floodplain modeling/mapping, stormwater facilities, culverts, pollution control and treatment, and preserving the quality of the environment by averting the contamination and degradation of water resources. Substantiates reports and documentation to advise on field conditions, proposed design, and likely ecological and environmental outcomes. Provides and assists environmental site assessment, corrective strategies, and with recommendations to address degradation of water resources. Ensures that responsibilities are delivered and adhered to with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable industry standards.

Your Impact

Provide guidance with data collection efforts for collecting, identifying, and compiling data from samples of water, sludge, and other matrices for projects, investigations, and surveys.
Perform high-level professional water resources engineering work and conduct investigations, analysis, and inspections relating to river/stream/habitat restoration and fish passage, stormwater facilities, culverts, hydrology, open channel hydraulics, floodplain modeling/mapping, hydrologic/hydraulic modeling, and pollution control and treatment activities to avert the contamination and degradation of water resources and determine conformance with applicable rules, standards, and permits.
Oversee and monitor cross-functional teams to execute mid-level projects including, budgets, tracking hours and expenses, task completion, permit applications, compliance documentation, and regulatory and technical analysis memos.
Develop and inform proposal and project scopes, timelines, pricing, and budgetary metrics – and accountable for planning, development and management of projects in compliance with all applicable City/State/federal codes and regulations, and in accordance with all acceptable engineering practices.
Coordinate, review and approve design plans, ensuring data integrity and work is compliant with all applicable codes, ordinances, and regulations.
Prepare data and visualizations such as tables, charts, reports, models, cross-sections, and other illustrations for the interpretation or presentation of more complex data, findings, or analyses.
Prepare comprehensive technical reports and presentations that explain research, findings, and recommendations to prevent, control, restore, clean-up, or address environmental issues or problems.
Interpret and summarize data, including reports and documents that result in sound engineering, engineering, and regulatory conclusions.
Perform concept level design of treatments and analyze hydrologic and hydraulic models and computations for storm water and watershed master planning, stream restoration, and water quality studies.
Design a variety of facilities, primarily river/stream/habitat restoration but may include bioretentions, green roofs, permeable pavements, stormwater ponds, manufactured treatment devices, and underground detention facilities.
Prepare watershed studies, floodplain studies, and evaluate regulated impoundment structures for compliance with regulations.
Prepare and implement site Health and Safety Plans (HASPs).
Interact with regulatory agencies, subcontractors, and clients in a confident and professional manner.
Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide future ready solutions for clients.
Remain current in latest water resources engineering techniques.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering, with a focus in Water Resources or closely related discipline.
7 to 10 years of relevant post education experience in water resources engineering.
Engineer license preferred.
Proficient knowledge of water resource engineering principles, practices, process, design/build, and the application to environmental permitting and project work-related issues.
Well-defined knowledge with Ecological Restoration, Stormwater Management, Drainage, Erosion and Sediment Control, Hydrology & Hydraulics Design, Watershed Studies, Floodplain Delineation, etc.
Proficient ability to coordinate with agency regulators and understand requirements.
Well-defined specific knowledge of relevant environmental laws, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements.
Well-developed ability to make technical computations and calculations involving the application of engineering principles, understanding plans and specifications and making factual comparisons to the appropriate regulations.
Ability to plan and conduct inspections and investigations on various aspects of the construction and design of facilities or structures, applying applicable regulations and policies
Highly effective interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non-engineering audience.
Demonstrated high-level of self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
Works independently with minimal oversight and provides guidance and leadership to junior team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Highly proficient with technical writing, office automation, software, technology, math principles, predictive models, spreadsheets, and tools.
Adept at coordinating technical matters with public and private groups.
Proficient understanding of and well-defined experience with surface water analysis, hydrologic methodologies/models (TR-55, HEC-HMS, etc.), hydraulic models (HEC-RAS, HEC-RAS-2D, HEC-GeoRAS, SRH-2D, etc.), and with ESRI ArcGIS software.
Working knowledge of FEMA flood studies, floodplain analysis and hazards analysis.
Well-developed critical thinking and problem-solving skills required to apply technical knowledge to reach conclusions from testing results, data collation, statistical analysis and arriving at the most effective, economical, and logical solution.
Demonstrated effectiveness at coordinating and assertively directing subcontractors and others to consistently complete tasks safely and efficiently.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.

What You Will Be Doing

The Project Manager's (PM) role is to plan and manage construction activities from conception to completion of the project in a timely and cost-effective manner. The PM responsibilities include, but are not limited to; project planning, budget management, schedule implementation, compliance with quality standards, contract administration and safety program management. 

GENERAL INFORMATION:
- Project Manager
- Exempt position
- Worksite location at construction jobsite trailer, or main offices, depending on company needs
- Reports to executive team members (VP of Construction, VP of Operations, CEO, etc.)
- Works closely with Project Superintendent, jobsite staff, main office staff, vendors, subcontractors, design professionals and clients.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / TASKS:
- Ensure that construction activities move according to predetermined schedule, mitigating and reporting all potential delays by monitoring the progress of the construction activities on a regular basis and holding weekly status meetings with all the team members, subcontractors and clients and their consultants.
- Coordinate the efforts of all parties involved in the project, which include clients, architects, consultants, subcontractors and laborers.
- Maintain strict adherence to the budgetary guidelines, quality and safety standards.
- Daily inspection of construction site to monitor compliance with building and safety codes, and other applicable regulations.
- Study job specifications to determine appropriate construction methods.
- Identify the elements of project design and construction likely to produce constructability issues and plan coordination problems prior to beginning construction of the project. 
- Interpret and explain plans and contract terms to administrative staff, subcontractors, and clients
- Select, contract, and oversee workers who complete specific scopes of the project, such as painting or plumbing
- Prepare subcontracts and negotiate revisions, changes and additions to contractual agreements 
- Manage the budget, track project expenses and minimize exposure and risk in the project
- Collect, review and approve progress payments submitted by all subcontractors and vendors
- Ensure project documentation and reports are complete
- Handling complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others

jobs.description:
Description

The Cybersecurity Analyst supports the security, compliance, and maintenance of information systems throughout the Risk Management Framework (RMF) lifecycle, from system preparation through decommissioning. This role ensures alignment with Intelligence Community Directive (ICD), Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA), and Department of Defense (DoD) cybersecurity policies and standards.

The analyst works closely with Information System Security Managers (ISSMs), Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), Security Control Assessors (SCAs), Program Managers (PMs), and other stakeholders to execute RMF activities, reduce cybersecurity risk, and improve the overall security posture of supported systems. This position focuses on driving meaningful security outcomes through vulnerability management, continuous monitoring, compliance support, and risk-informed decision-making.

Roles And Responsibilities

Support information systems throughout the RMF lifecycle, ensuring compliance with applicable cybersecurity policies, standards, and regulations.
Collaborate with ISSMs, ISSOs, SCAs, PMs, and other stakeholders to support security initiatives and compliance efforts.
Assist stakeholders in understanding cybersecurity risks, vulnerability impacts, and remediation priorities to improve system security posture.
Provide technical support for continuous monitoring activities, compliance reporting, and audit readiness initiatives.
Evaluate cybersecurity implications of system modifications, upgrades, and configuration changes.
Support implementation, assessment, and documentation of security controls.
Maintain and update cybersecurity documentation, authorization packages, and RMF artifacts.
Document vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and security findings clearly to support remediation planning and stakeholder awareness.
Utilize Xacta or similar Cyber Risk Management platforms to manage risk assessments, security control evidence, compliance status, and POA&M activities.
Track and manage POA&M items to ensure vulnerabilities identified through scans, assessments, or audits are properly documented, mitigated, and resolved.
Analyze vulnerability and compliance data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for security improvements.
Promote cybersecurity best practices and ensure alignment with organizational and mission objectives.

Knowledge

Knowledge of the Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST 800-series publications, Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS), Security Authorization and Assessment (SA&A) processes, continuous monitoring, POA&M management, and vulnerability management.
Understanding of cybersecurity compliance requirements within DoD, DIA, and Intelligence Community environments.
Familiarity with cybersecurity risk management platforms such as Xacta and related compliance management tools.

Skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience interpreting vulnerability and compliance reports generated from tools such as Xacta, STIG Viewer, ACAS, Prisma, Splunk, Trellix (HBSS), or similar security platforms.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to identify root causes of security issues and recommend practical remediation strategies.
Experience working across multiple teams and stakeholders to achieve security and compliance objectives.
Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and accuracy.
Strong organizational skills and ability to maintain comprehensive security documentation.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Obtain and maintain an IAT Level III certification, or maintain an IAT Level II certification, in accordance with DoD 8570.01-M and DoD Directive 8140 Cyberspace Workforce Management requirements.
Acceptable certifications include: CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+), CompTIA Security+, EC-Council Certified Network Defender (CND v3), CCNA Security, Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP), GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC), Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP)

Clearence

Active Top Secret clearance is required with SCI eligibility and the ability to Pass CI Poly

As our Engineering Project Manager, you’ll be based on our purpose-built Hemel Hempstead testing laboratory, that delivers testing across a wide range of industry sectors and product types including PPE, Latex, IoT Security, Automotive, Fire detection, Doors & Windows, and Construction Products.

In this role you will be working closely with our internal stakeholders to understand each individual project need, scope of works and project deliverables; managing projects from cradle to grave.

You’ll take full ownership for the project management and delivery of new test equipment, following a design and build cycle across our Product Certification testing facility at Hemel Hempstead. You will oversee projects from requirement capture through solution consideration, construction phase and final handover to stakeholders.

Key Duties

The Engineering Project Manager will be responsible for the management of turn-key projects from cradle to grave.
You’ll work alongside Lab Subject Matter Experts, calibration, maintenance, safety etc to understand the requirements of a given test rig/facility and project requirements.
Work with the design team to generate concept solutions, through to agreed final solution. Through this cycle the project manager will remain responsible for the design workload and eventual output.
Working in collaboration with the Project team and service providers, you will be responsible for delivering the equipment/rig/improvement into the live environment in line with the agreed solution.
Ensure validation of all requirements is obtained during the build cycle and prior to handover.
The role will require you to manage contractors/service providers and communicate progress to the internal client, complete with validation stages.
On project completion you will be responsible for project handover, ensuring all information and required documentation is handed over including maintenance support documentation/activity, declaration of conformity, schemes of examination and calibration requirements etc.
Throughout the projects you will be required to provide weekly reporting to the Programme Manager on all activities capturing key metrics throughout all stages.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

We are seeking an experienced project manager who holds a high level of technical/engineering experience.
You will have a proven background in the implementation and delivery of multiple, complex engineering focused projects.
Ideally, you will be qualified to at least HNC/HND (or similar) standard within a technical/engineering discipline.
Completion of a formal project management qualification/certification.
High awareness of Health & Safety such as method statements and risk assessments.
You’ll need to be a self-starter with the ability to work under your own initiate with limited supervision.
You will be working closely with internal stakeholders, external clients, contracting teams and suppliers, so excellent communication and people management skills are paramount.
The ability to evaluate and control cost and make sound financial recommendations to ensure projects are delivered within specified budgets is also crucial.

What We Offer

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training, and development with the inclusion of Annual Bonus, Contribution Based Pension, Private Healthcare, 27 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays, Income Protection & Life Assurance.

If you require any reasonable accommodation to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

About Us

BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.

Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.

Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.

Job Description

Rattaché(e) au Responsable de la sécurité des systèmes d’information (RSSI) Groupe, vous contribuez à la maîtrise des risques cyber et à la protection des données. Vous accompagnez les métiers et les fonctions technologiques dans la mise en œuvre d’exigences de sécurité adaptées aux enjeux du Groupe.

Activités clés et responsabilités de l’Information Security Manager (ISM) Groupe

L’ISM contribue à la gouvernance de la sécurité de l’information et au pilotage des risques cyber à l’échelle du Groupe. À ce titre, ses principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :

Contribuer à la définition, au déploiement et à l’évolution du cadre de gouvernance de la cybersécurité et de la protection des données, en cohérence avec l’appétence au risque et les priorités du Groupe.
Assurer une veille sur les menaces, les vulnérabilités et les évolutions réglementaires, en évaluer les impacts et conseiller les parties prenantes sur les plans d’action à engager.
Contribuer au dispositif de gestion des risques d’entreprise en supervisant les risques cyber, en maintenant l’environnement de contrôle et en assurant un reporting clair à destination des instances de gouvernance.
Accompagner les projets et initiatives du Groupe en réalisant des analyses de risques de sécurité, des revues d’architecture et des évaluations de due diligence auprès des tiers.
Définir, avec les parties prenantes métiers et technologiques, des mesures de réduction des risques proportionnées, pragmatiques et alignées sur les objectifs opérationnels.
Évaluer l’adéquation et l’efficacité des mesures de sécurité au regard des réglementations, politiques, directives, procédures et contrôles applicables.
Soutenir le RSSI Groupe dans la mise en œuvre, le pilotage et l’amélioration continue des programmes de cybersécurité et de protection des données.

Profil

Master en cybersécurité, en sécurité de l’information, en informatique ou formation jugée équivalente.
Une ou plusieurs certifications reconnues en sécurité de l’information (CISSP, CISM, CRISC ou équivalent) et/ou en protection des données constituent un atout.
Au moins cinq ans d’expérience en gestion des risques cyber, en cybersécurité ou en protection des données, ainsi qu’une solide compréhension des enjeux techniques. Une expérience dans le secteur bancaire ou financier constitue un atout.
Bonne maîtrise des référentiels de cybersécurité et de contrôle, notamment du NIST CSF et de la norme ISO/IEC 27001.
Bonne compréhension des architectures informatiques, des réseaux, des environnements cloud et des télécommunications.
Maîtrise des principes de sécurité des environnements cloud publics, privés et hybrides, notamment des modèles de responsabilité partagée et des bonnes pratiques de sécurisation des services IaaS, PaaS et SaaS.
Expérience dans l’évaluation et la mise en œuvre de contrôles de sécurité cloud : gestion des identités et des accès, chiffrement et gestion des clés, journalisation et surveillance, gestion des configurations, segmentation réseau et protection des données.
Expérience pratique de la sécurisation des environnements Microsoft 365 et Microsoft Azure, notamment de Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview, Azure Policy et Microsoft Sentinel. Maîtrise de la configuration des accès conditionnels, de la gestion des identités privilégiées, de la protection des données et de la surveillance des événements de sécurité.
Connaissance des exigences applicables aux institutions financières, notamment celles de la FINMA, de la CSSF, de l’ACPR, de l’AMF et de l’EBA. Une expérience de leur mise en œuvre constitue un atout.
Forte capacité d’analyse, d’apprentissage et d’adaptation dans un environnement en évolution rapide.
Sens élevé de l’éthique, de l’intégrité et de la confidentialité.
Rigueur, proactivité, précision, sens des priorités et excellente organisation.
Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles, capacité à fédérer des interlocuteurs variés et goût du travail en équipe.
Maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
Excellentes capacités de synthèse, de communication et de rédaction, adaptées aux publics techniques, métiers et dirigeants.
Capacité à coordonner plusieurs parties prenantes et à conduire des sujets de manière autonome.

Sans nouvelles de notre part sous un mois, vous pourrez considérer que votre candidature n'aura pas été retenue.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to join our team.

This is not a conventional project management role. We are looking for an experienced PM who has delivered external, customer-facing software implementations against a contractual scope of work, and who has been close enough to the technology to understand what it takes to move a solution from requirements to production.

The Technical Project Manager leads end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-year implementations on our Evoke platform. Our engagements involve highly regulated state government environments, politically sensitive stakeholder ecosystems, and configuration-driven solutions built on a platform that is still being actively developed. You will be hands-on where it matters most, including requirements gathering and prioritization, configuration versus development tradeoffs, and complex data migrations.

Strong project managers who cannot engage at the technical level will struggle with the complexity of our engagements. Equally, technically strong candidates who have not delivered to a contract for an external client will not have the command these projects require. Both dimensions matter.

Reports to:
Manager of Professional Services

Location:
100% Remote (must be eligible to work in the U.S.); Travel 10-15%.

Compensation:
Base salary, commensurate with experience. Eligible for the company's commission plan and profit sharing.

About The Company

System Automation (SA) has built solutions for state and local regulatory agencies for over twenty-five years. Our SaaS platform is trusted by 500 government agencies, spans 5,000 industries, and serves over 20 million licensees.

Our mission is to positively disrupt the regulatory software market by incubating new ideas, collaborating with our customers, and building technology with real-world impact. We challenge the status quo, aren't afraid to experiment, and build products that improve the states and cities we live in.

Requirements

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Technical Engagement & Delivery Oversight

Closely oversee requirements gathering and prioritization, ensuring every requirement traces to the contracted scope and carries clear acceptance criteria before it enters the build queue.
Guide tradeoffs between configuration and development with Solution Architects and Functional Consultants. Favor reusable configuration and templates.
Oversee complex data migrations, including mapping, mock conversions, reconciliation, and cutover readiness.
Review proposed solution approaches before build, raising gaps, misalignments with user stories, and risks before they are locked into the project plan.
Deliver on a platform under active development by staying current on Evoke releases, identifying opportunities to use new capabilities, and surfacing platform gaps to product and engineering.
Maintain working awareness platform constraints, data residency, and compliance considerations, and make sure they are accounted for in planning and design.
Translate technical tradeoffs into clear, decision-ready communications for non-technical client stakeholders and executive sponsors.

Project & Program Management

Own the full project lifecycle, from initiation through closure, on multi-year, multi-stakeholder government implementations.
Develop and maintain resource-loaded schedules, and manage milestones, resource allocations, and time budgets with precision.
Drive milestone completion and profitability targets in coordination with the Professional Services Manager and leadership team.
Manage delivery against the contracted scope of work, escalating scope creep with documented analysis and a recommended disposition before it affects budget or schedule.
Manage risk registers with rigor, including quantification, ownership, and tracked mitigation across the project portfolio.
Produce accurate, professional status reports for internal leadership and client audiences.
Support business development through proposal scoping, effort estimation, and project plan development.

Stakeholder Management & Client Engagement

Navigate stakeholder environments with competing interests, politically motivated demands, and shifting priorities across agency leadership, program staff, and end users.
Serve as the primary point of accountability for client relationships on assigned projects, maintaining trust through difficult conversations on scope, timelines, and budget.
Run structured weekly status meetings with client stakeholders and facilitate executive-level reviews with appropriate preparation and gravitas.
Collaborate with the Support Manager, Solution Architects, and functional leadership to coordinate resources, resolve cross-functional issues, and ensure a smooth transition to post-go-live support.

PMO & Quality Governance

Enforce delivery standards, including documentation quality, acceptance criteria rigor, and milestone completion gates.
Champion backlog prioritization discipline so development effort goes to contractually mandated requirements in order of client value.
Hold team members accountable for task completion, deliverable quality, and professional conduct in client-facing interactions.
Forecast milestone completion and financial burn in Workday Adaptive, and surface early warnings when projects deviate from plan.

Qualifications

Experience

4+ years managing external, customer-facing software implementation projects where scope, deliverables, and acceptance are defined in a contract, with responsibility for schedule, budget, and client relationship. Projects must include a full requirements, design, build, and feedback loop, not only deployment of packaged software.
Hands-on involvement in complex data migrations from legacy systems.
Experience managing mixed teams of employees and external contractors.

Preferred Experience

Past projects that built custom solutions on a low-code or no-code platform, using reusable configuration and templates. Qualifying platforms include Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Power Platform, Appian, Pega, OutSystems, Mendix, or comparable platforms.
Exposure to government customers or highly regulated industries. Direct domain experience in professional licensing, permitting, enforcement, inspections, investigations, or compliance management will be given significant preference.
Projects with budgets over $1M and durations of 12+ months.

Technical Foundation (meet at least one)

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in an information technology discipline, such as computer science, software engineering, or information systems.
Professional experience as a programmer, developer, or solution or technical architect.
Professional experience as a product owner or product manager responsible for requirements and backlog on a software product.
Professional experience as a project manager of a custom software project, not an ERP, CRM, or COTS product implementation.

Technical Proficiency

Working understanding of cloud platform architecture, preferably Microsoft Azure.
Verifiable experience running agile and blended waterfall/agile projects, with the ability to meet government clients where they are and bring them progressively toward iterative delivery.
Ability to read and critically evaluate technical documentation, data models, integration designs, and workflow specifications.
Proficiency with Jira, including workflows, board configuration, and automation rules, used as a delivery management tool and not only a task tracker.
Proficiency with Microsoft Project and/or Unanet for schedule management. Familiarity with financial forecasting tools is preferred.
Enough technical fluency to recognize when a proposed approach raises delivery risk, and to ask the right questions rather than accept every recommendation at face value.

Certifications

PMP or PRINCE2 is desirable but not required. Verifiable experience and outcomes are weighted heavily.
Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
Azure or low-code platform certification is a meaningful differentiator.

Competencies & Personal Attributes

The following attributes are as important as the technical and experiential qualifications above.

Executive Presence. You command a room, with clients, contractors, and internal leadership alike, through preparation, clarity, and composure.
Structured Thinking. You impose order on complexity. You decompose problems systematically, distinguish symptoms from root causes, and communicate findings without oversimplification.
Accountability Orientation. You hold yourself and your teams to commitments. When things go wrong, you lead the recovery and do not redistribute blame.
Stakeholder Empathy. You understand that government clients operate under political, organizational, and budgetary constraints that require patience, adaptability, and the ability to build trust incrementally.
Scope Discipline. You treat scope creep as a delivery risk, not a customer service opportunity. You manage to the contract, say no constructively, and document the implications of yes.
Technical Curiosity. You are genuinely interested in how software gets built, not just whether it gets shipped. You ask hard questions about platform behavior, configuration choices, and implementation tradeoffs because you have been close enough to the work to know what can go wrong.

What To Expect

Hiring Process:
Application review -- interviews and technical assessment -- conditional offer

Security Screening: Due to the sensitive nature of IT systems and data access, final candidates will receive a conditional employment offer contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening and a fingerprint-based background investigation.

We may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence tools, to assist recruiters and hiring managers in reviewing application materials and identifying qualifications relevant to a position. These tools support, but do not replace human decision-making. All employment decisions are made by qualified human reviewers. Applicants requiring accommodation during the application or selection process may contact us at hr@systemautomation.com.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

About IXOPAY

IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey.

From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence.

We're looking for a GTM Project Manager to help bring IXOPAY's payment technology products and capabilities to market.

In this cross-functional role, you'll coordinate product launches and go-to-market initiatives, ensuring new capabilities are introduced with clear messaging, aligned teams, effective enablement, and measurable outcomes. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, and Client Success, you'll help turn product development into successful launches that drive customer adoption and business growth.

You'll take ownership of launch planning and execution, coordinate internal readiness, develop enablement materials, and track adoption and performance after release. You'll also help strengthen the processes, reporting, and collaboration that connect Product development with our commercial teams.

This is an opportunity to combine strong program management and communication skills with product strategy and go-to-market execution, helping shape how IXOPAY introduces innovative payment solutions to enterprise customers around the world.

What You'll Do

Drive Product Launches & GTM Readiness

Plan, coordinate, and execute go-to-market activities for new products, features, and capabilities using IXOPAY's product launch framework.

Enable Sales, Solutions & Customer-Facing Teams

Coordinate Strategic Product Initiatives

Identify opportunities to improve product-to-GTM handoffs, launch processes, and cross-functional collaboration.
Support Product team operations, including planning meetings and workshops, maintaining documentation, and coordinating vendor-related activities.
Develop repeatable workflows and processes that improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability across product initiatives.

Track Product Adoption & GTM Performance

Establish and maintain reporting that tracks product launches, adoption, enablement effectiveness, and other relevant performance indicators.
Develop dashboards and regular updates that provide Product and GTM leadership with visibility into launch progress and outcomes.
Gather post-launch feedback from Sales, Client Success, customers, and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement.

Use data and insights to continuously improve launch execution, enablement, and product adoption strategies.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.

Experience bringing API-first, developer-focused, or enterprise SaaS products to market.
Familiarity with payment orchestration, tokenization, payment processing, or related technologies.
Experience developing product enablement programs or supporting technical product launches.
Experience working with product adoption metrics, launch performance reporting, and customer feedback.

At IXOPAY, you'll help bring innovative payment technology to market, connecting product development with the teams and customers who rely on our solutions.

You'll work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Marketing, and commercial strategy, helping introduce new capabilities across payment orchestration, tokenization, AI Payments Intelligence, and emerging payment technologies.

(preferred)

They will work on data-driven, complex projects that aid in the success of integrated digital campaigns across inbound and outbound channels. The Senior Project Manager collaborates cross-functionally with internal stakeholders both within and beyond marketing. The ideal candidate has proven experience maintaining relationships and managing projects for all client levels, complexity and sophistication.

What You'll Do

Own responsibility for all project aspects to ensure alignment and organization within the marketing department.
Ensure milestones are successfully met with the ability to anticipate workload and allocate/coordinate resources needed for project success.
Work cross-functionally to develop and manage project and campaign briefs and provide feedback on deliverables to ensure they meet the objective and raise the bar.
Manage team calendar which includes internal team status meetings, multiple weekly client status calls, and work review meetings.
Proactively contact clients to finalize project specifications and provide consultative updates throughout the project life cycle.
Own triage of new project requests, ensuring ClickUp tasks are submitted with all information & assets available ahead of scheduling.
Align with Account Managers and client to remain in full communication on the status and details of each project.
Lead weekly/daily status meetings with cross-functional departments to assure the coordination of all projects.
Lead or co-lead weekly/biweekly client meetings to define deliverable specifications and ensure strategic alignment

What You'll Bring

5-7 years of project management experience in an agency, in-house, or start-up environment.
Expertise in at least 2+ areas within the digital advertising landscape - SEM, Paid Social Ads, SEO, analytics and attribution.
2-3+ years managing paid search and social campaigns - Google Ads, Facebook, LinkedIn.
Proven track record with cross-functional collaboration and achieving high customer satisfaction.
Relevant experience within the digital advertising landscape and related technologies.
Proven ability to lead Scrum ceremonies, meeting structure, and use of industry terminology.
Excellent organizational skills and ability to grasp all department timelines that could impact project scope.
Comfort with business analytics and producing data-driven insights and reports.
Comfort managing Executive expectations and feedback.
Strong experience managing relationships/project management accounts for all client levels, complexity and sophistication.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with stakeholders at all levels.

Benefits And Perks We Provide

Remote Workplace. You have the option to work at our office in Boston or remotely in one of these states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, ID, IL, KY, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NV, NH, NJ, NY, NC, SC, OH, OK, PA, RI, TN, TX, UT, VA.
